alembic.whatItIs: A tool for recording and applying database structure changes in SQLAlchemy projects.
goodAt: Managing changes to SQL tables over time
notGoodAt: Hosting a database; arrange that separately.
alembic.example: Apply a reviewed change that adds a column.

asyncpg.whatItIs: An asynchronous PostgreSQL driver for Python.
goodAt: Connecting Python services to Postgres without blocking on queries
notGoodAt: Designing database tables; use a modeling tool.
asyncpg.example: Read a saved record from Postgres in an async handler.

fastapi.whatItIs: A Python framework for building HTTP APIs from typed functions.
goodAt: Building API endpoints with request validation
notGoodAt: Providing a database automatically; add one.
fastapi.example: Accept a request and return a validated response.

httpx.whatItIs: A Python library for making HTTP requests with synchronous or asynchronous code.
goodAt: Calling external web services from Python
notGoodAt: Serving your own HTTP API; use a server framework.
httpx.example: Fetch data from another service in a Python task.

mypy.whatItIs: A tool that checks Python type annotations before code runs.
goodAt: Finding type mismatches in Python code
notGoodAt: Validating external data at runtime; use a data validator.
mypy.example: Catch a function call with the wrong argument type.

pydantic.whatItIs: A Python library for validating data with type annotations.
goodAt: Checking request and settings data at runtime
pydantic.example: Reject an incoming record with a missing field.

pydantic-settings.whatItIs: A Pydantic library for loading and validating application settings.
notGoodAt: Managing secrets outside the app; use a secret store.
pydantic-settings.example: Check that a required database address is configured.

pytest.whatItIs: A Python test runner with fixtures and assertions.
goodAt: Running Python unit and integration tests
notGoodAt: Testing a real browser; use browser automation.
pytest.example: Run API tests after changing a handler.

pytest-asyncio.whatItIs: Adds support for testing Python asynchronous functions with pytest.

pytest-cov.whatItIs: Adds code coverage measurement to pytest runs.

pytest-randomly.whatItIs: Shuffles pytest test order to expose order dependence and controls random seeds for repeatable failures.

pytest-xdist.whatItIs: Runs pytest tests across multiple worker processes.

goodAt: Finding lint issues and formatting Python code
ruff.example: Format Python files and report unused imports.

sqlalchemy.whatItIs: A Python library for defining database models and queries.
goodAt: Working with SQL databases from Python
notGoodAt: Applying schema changes alone; use a migration tool.
sqlalchemy.example: Load an inventory record through a database model.

structlog.whatItIs: A Python library for building structured log events.
goodAt: Adding consistent fields to application logs
notGoodAt: Collecting or storing logs; configure that separately.
structlog.example: Attach a request identifier to an API log event.

uvicorn.whatItIs: A server that runs Python web apps so they can receive HTTP requests.
notGoodAt: Providing API routes; use a web framework.
uvicorn.example: Start a FastAPI application for local requests.
